proactiveAudio.description: Optional. If enabled, the model can reject responding to the last prompt. For example, this allows the model to ignore out of context speech or to stay silent if the user did not make a request, yet.

proactiveVideo.description: Optional. If enabled, the system might trigger a generation on each received image. This requires that `proactive_audio` is enabled. The rate of generation depends on the rate of incoming images and can cause a significant increase in cost.
